svg.text: An alarm fires, an agent finds the cause, a person approves the fix. IAM, not the prompt, decides what it can touch.
5xx, errors, throttles, queue age, no traffic
cites evidence, proposes one call + its undo
Describe / List / Get, Logs Insights, metrics, CloudTrail
every step, call, cost and decision
THREE CHECKS BETWEEN THE MODEL AND THE ACCOUNT
1 · IAM role the tools run as
AWS ReadOnlyAccess, minus object reads, table
items, queue messages, secrets and KMS decrypt.
It cannot see its own model key.
A real API call with valid parameters, an undo
call, no deletes, IAM, KMS or access settings,
nothing named oncall-*, at most 3 writes.
3 · IAM role the executor runs as
Writes only to resources tagged oncall=managed.
A permission boundary blocks destructive actions
even if the role policy is widened by mistake.
